values.note: $23 a site; 25% off when the water is off. Max 8 people per site.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/sleeping-elephant-campground ('Single Site: $23 per night'; 'Fees are discounted 25% when water is off.'; 'A single site may hold up to eight people.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes RD Campground Status: Sleeping Elephant, Fee $23), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Parking spurs 15 to 30 ft (the campground page); the forest's campground-status table lists the max spur as 20 ft. Rigs must fit on the spur. FS: 'an older facility and will not accommodate larger RVs.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/sleeping-elephant-campground ('There are 15 sites'; 'RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur because driving or parking off road is not permitted. note: Roosevelt NF (Canyon Lakes RD) campground beside Hwy 14 in Poudre Canyon, ~43 mi west of US 287, ~7,800 ft, in open ponderosa pine with a view of Sleeping Elephant Mountain. The Cache la Poudre River runs across the highway, mostly through private land here. --Claude
